items.distractor_fact: Ein Kollege maß zur gleichen Zeit mit seinem eigenen Thermometer {D} Grad Celsius.
items.gloss_en: A colleague measured {D} degrees Celsius at the same time with his own thermometer.
items.entity_note: A colleague (a person, with his own instrument), not a neighboring village (a place) as in the first distractor; not the thermometer whose afternoon/morning readings the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Eine Anleihe schloss am selben Tag bei {D} Euro.
items.gloss_en: A bond closed that same day at {D} euros.
items.entity_note: A bond (a financial instrument), not a different company (an organization) as in the first distractor; not the stock whose opening/closing price the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Eine private Messstation registrierte am selben Abend einen Pegel von {D} Zentimetern.
items.gloss_en: A private monitoring station recorded a level of {D} centimeters that same evening.
items.entity_note: A private monitoring station (an instrument), not a different river (a place) as in the first distractor; not the river whose evening/morning readings the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Ein Freund zahlte am selben Tag {D} Euro auf sein Sparbuch ein.
items.gloss_en: A friend deposited {D} euros into his own passbook that same day.
items.entity_note: A friend (a named person), not an unspecified different account as in the first distractor; not the account whose deposit/withdrawal the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Ein einzelner Angestellter hatte im selben Monat Ausgaben von {D} Euro.
items.gloss_en: A single employee had expenses of {D} euros that same month.
items.entity_note: An individual employee (a person), not a different household (a family entity) as in the first distractor; not the household whose income/expenses the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Ein einzelner Spieler erzielte in einer anderen Liga {D} Tore.
items.gloss_en: An individual player scored {D} goals in a different league.
items.entity_note: An individual player (a person), not a different team (an organization) as in the first distractor; not the team whose scored/conceded goals the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Ein Investmentfonds verzeichnete im selben Jahr Gewinne von {D} Euro.
items.gloss_en: An investment fund recorded gains of {D} euros that same year.
items.entity_note: An investment fund (an organization), not a different investor (a person) as in the first distractor; not the investor whose gains/losses the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Ein selbstständiger Handwerker stellte im selben Monat {D} Stück her.
items.gloss_en: A self-employed craftsman produced {D} units that same month.
items.entity_note: A self-employed craftsman (a person, with no stated quota), not a different factory (an organization) as in the first distractor; not the factory whose actual/planned output the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Eine private Wetterstation maß im selben Monat {D} Millimeter Niederschlag.
items.gloss_en: A private weather station measured {D} millimeters of rainfall that same month.
items.entity_note: A private weather station (an instrument, with no stated forecast), not a different region (a place) as in the first distractor; not the region whose actual/forecast rainfall the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Auf einem anderen Golfplatz waren für ein Loch {D} Schläge nötig.
items.gloss_en: On a different golf course, {D} strokes were needed for a hole.
items.entity_note: A different golf course (a place, whose own par is not stated), not a different golfer (a person) as in the first distractor; not the golfer/hole the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Auf einem anderen Golfplatz waren für eine Runde {D} Schläge nötig.
items.gloss_en: On a different golf course, {D} strokes were needed for a round.
items.entity_note: A different golf course (a place, whose own par is not stated), not a different golfer (a person) as in the first distractor; not the golfer/round the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Bei einer anderen Bahngesellschaft erreichte ein Zug den Bahnhof {D} Minuten nach Mitternacht.
items.gloss_en: At a different train company, a train reached the station {D} minutes after midnight.
items.entity_note: A different train company (an organization, whose own schedule is not stated), not a different train on a different line (an instrument/series) as in the first distractor; not the train whose actual/scheduled arrival the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Bei einer anderen Fluggesellschaft landete ein Flugzeug {D} Minuten nach Mitternacht.
items.gloss_en: At a different airline, a plane landed {D} minutes after midnight.
items.entity_note: A different airline (an organization, whose own schedule is not stated), not a different flight on a different route (an instrument/series) as in the first distractor; not the flight whose actual/scheduled landing the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Eine andere Behörde meldete am selben Tag einen Wasserstand von {D} Zentimetern.
items.gloss_en: A different authority reported a water level of {D} centimeters that same day.
items.entity_note: A different authority (an organization, with its own unstated reference line), not a different sensor at a different site (an instrument) as in the first distractor; not the sensor whose level/reference the question compares.
